post_call_analysis_data.name: primary_intent
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's main situation. needs_help_now: life safety (medical, trapped, fire at the house). needs_help_leaving: can leave only with help (wheelchair, oxygen, no car, children alone). leaving: will leave. staying: refuses or undecided. already_left: out of the zone. hazard_report: reports smoke, fire, damage or injury, or a sentinel says the alert matches what they see. no_hazard_seen: a sentinel sees nothing. info_request: only asked a question. wrong_number, not_in_zone, unclear, voicemail, silence: no usable answer. On the heat check-in line (mode heat): needs_help_now = heat-stroke warning signs or feeling unwell in the heat; needs_help_leaving = needs a ride to a cooling center; leaving = going to a cooling center or somewhere cool; already_left = at home and cool; staying = staying home and declining help (or wants a check-in visit). Block-by-block evacuation: a resident told their block's wave is later who will go with it is leaving, not staying.

post_call_analysis_data.name: needs
post_call_analysis_data.description: Access and functional needs mentioned, comma-separated, using only these words: wheelchair, walker, no_car, oxygen, powered_medical_device, dialysis, bedbound, children_alone, hearing, vision, cognitive, other. Empty if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: people
post_call_analysis_data.description: Number of people at the address including the speaker, if stated.

post_call_analysis_data.name: can_leave
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether the person said they can leave on their own.

post_call_analysis_data.name: location_text
post_call_analysis_data.description: Where the person said they are right now, in their words (address, intersection or landmark). Empty if not said.

post_call_analysis_data.name: live_location_consent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the agent asked whether it may text a link that shares the person's live location with the response team and the person clearly said yes. False if they said no or were never asked clearly. A maybe is false. A yes to sharing the place they named (no text link) is false.

post_call_analysis_data.name: live_location_quote
post_call_analysis_data.description: If live_location_consent is true: the person's own words saying yes, verbatim. Empty otherwise.

action.text: Leave a short voicemail in {{language}}; keep your own words brief. Say this is the emergency information line (if the mode {{mode}} is heat: the heat check-in line; if base: the installation's emergency line) and the verification phrase {{verification_phrase}}. If {{simulated}} is true, say this is a simulated call for a hackathon demonstration. If the purpose {{purpose}} is resident or linked_contact, read exactly and in full, translated faithfully if needed, adding nothing and cutting nothing, even if that makes the message long: "{{directive_text}}" then "{{move_text}}" then the evacuation point "{{evac_point}}", skipping any that is (none) and skipping the evacuation point if the route text already names it. For any other purpose do not read an alert or a directive. Never say anyone is safe and never give a time. End with the official callback number {{callback_number}}.
